description: This Java class is an immutable implementation of a live command for retrieving feature properties within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract query class and implements an interface, encapsulating command data such as feature ID and providing methods to create modified instances with headers and to generate answer builders.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable class implementing RetrieveFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand, encapsulating the feature ID and providing methods for setting headers and generating answer builders.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrieveFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandImpl from a generic Command object, casting it to RetrieveFeatureProperties.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this command instance.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the command with specified Ditto headers set.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new answer builder instance for this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this command instance for debugging.
